steps.title: Pull Pipettes Using Existing Program
steps.instruction: Use the DMZ-Zeitz Universal puller to manufacture glass pipettes for whole cell patch clamp recording.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the power to the pipette puller using the MAINS switch.
Press P(A), enter the desired program number, press E, and press Ready.
Insert a glass pipette into the open glass holders.
For the left DMZ-Zeitz puller, push the pipette all the way to the right until it makes contact with the right positioning knob.
For the right DMZ-Zeitz puller, push the glass pipette all the way to the left until it makes contact with the stop.
Close the safety shield.
Press START to run the program and pull the pipettes.
Place the pulled pipettes into a storage box (e.g., Sutter Instruments BX20).

steps.title: Create and Optimize a New Program
steps.instruction: Establish a new program to achieve pipettes with a tip diameter of 1-1.5 µm and resistance of 3-6 MΩ.

substeps.instruction: Set up the program using initial values for a patching pipette from the operation manual for a single pull program (Table 1).
For single pull programs, set the first digit of P(B)AD to 0 (otherwise, this digit represents the polishing protocol time).
Fill the pipette with internal solution (SOP RP0234) and fill the bath with ACSF.IX (SOP RP0233).
Load one pipette at a time onto a head stage of an Ephys Rig.
Lower the pipette into the bath and apply a 10 mV test pulse to determine the tip resistance.
Measure the tip diameter under high magnification, measuring across the darkest part of the tip.
Adjust P(A)H to maintain a first pull duration of approximately 25 s.
Adjust P(B)t(F1) to modify diameter/resistance: increase P(B)t(F1) for larger diameter/lower resistance, or decrease it for smaller diameter/higher resistance.
Pull 3 sets of pipettes from the new program to ensure consistency of resistances (3-6 MΩ) and diameter (1-1.5 µm).

steps.title: Replace the Puller Filament
steps.instruction: Replace the heating filament in the puller when necessary, following safety precautions.

substeps.instruction: Turn the puller off and unplug it.
Wait 5 minutes for the heating mechanism to cool down if it was in use.
Remove the 4 screws holding the lower part of the right-hand cover panel.
Grasp the panel at the right-hand corner and remove it by pulling it up and towards yourself.
Use a screwdriver in the slit to give the spindle a few turns until the heating filament holder is in its most advanced position.
Loosen the small black grub screw of the upper filament holder using the hexagonal key from the spare parts box.
Loosen the knurled screw of the lower filament holder.
Insert the new filament as far as it will go into the slots.
Adjust the horizontal and vertical position of the filament by moving the upper and lower parts, ensuring the filament is not bent.
Tighten the screws and screw the metal cover back into place, ensuring the spindle is not screwed completely out of its hole.
